mapper.select: SELECT sys95_manual_id AS manual_id, sys95_reg_date::date AS reg_date, sys95_manual_type AS manual_type, f_cdnm('ManualType', sys95_manual_type, sys95_company_id, f_today()) AS manual_type_nm, sys10_file_id AS file_id, sys10_file_nm AS file_nm, sys10_file_ext AS file_ext, sys95_note AS note FROM sys95_manual INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_parent_id = sys95_manual_id WHERE sys95_manual_type LIKE #{manualType} AND CONCAT(sys10_file_nm, sys95_note) ILIKE #{searchText} AND COALESCE(sys95_public_yn, 'false') = 'true' ORDER BY sys10_reg_date DESC
